parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of ABS plastic, typically found in cooling fans. It consists of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air in a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame or housing of the fan, made of aluminum for structural support and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, providing mounting points and ensuring stability during operation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary, serving as the structural support for the rotating fan assembly.
